title: Central Bank Signals Surprise 75bps Rate Hike Amid Sticky Inflation
text: The monetary policy committee unexpectedly raised the benchmark interest rate by 75 basis points today, citing unyielding inflation and geopolitical oil shocks. Yields on long-term government debt surged, impacting capital borrowing costs across banking institutions.

title: Major Industrial Conglomerate Defaults on ₹1,200 Cr Working Capital Loan
text: A premier infrastructure firm has formally defaulted on its commercial debt obligations, triggering default provisions and credit spread widening across corporate lending desks. Lenders are provisioning for severe credit impairments.

title: Trade Rumors on Border Disruptions
text: Breaking: Heightened diplomatic standoffs escalate border closures, disrupting critical supply routes and fuel imports for commercial manufacturing. Equities tumble across industrial sectors.

title: Product Launch Announcement
text: Global Tech Corp successfully launches new enterprise analytics suite to positive client feedback. Adoption expected to climb gradually through next fiscal year.
